sources.title: Government of Bermuda, Public Holidays (last updated 15 April 2026): the schedule for 2026, 2027, 2028 and 2029
sources.said: Public holiday dates are set in accordance with the Public Holidays Act 1947. Where a public holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the next following weekday is observed as a public holiday under the Act. 2026: New Year's Day Thursday 1st January; Good Friday Friday 3rd April; Bermuda Day Friday 22nd May; National Heroes Day Monday 15th June; Emancipation Day Thursday 30th July; Mary Prince Day Friday 31st July; Labour Day Monday 7th September; Remembrance Day Wednesday 11th November; Christmas Day Friday 25th December; Boxing Day Saturday 26th December; ... Monday, 28th December 2026 will be kept as a public holiday. 2027: ... Bermuda Day Friday 28th May; National Heroes Day Monday 21st June; Emancipation Day Thursday 29th July; Mary Prince Day Friday 30th July; Labour Day Monday 6th September; ... Monday, 27th December 2027 and Tuesday, 28th December 2027 will be kept as public holidays. 2028: ... Monday, 3rd January 2028 and Monday, 13th November 2028 will be kept as public holidays. 2029: ... Monday, 12th November 2029 will be kept as a public holiday.
